readme.run: Register 2D histology sections (TIFF, PNG, JPEG) to a 3D NIfTI MRI volume
notes: Input is one 3D NIfTI MRI (.nii or .nii.gz) and one or more 2D histology sections.
Specify --axis (0/i, 1/j, 2/k; default 2) and --slice N (default middle slice).
Runs Greedy NMI rigid, affine, plane search and deformable SVF registration.
No network connection is required and no external model files are downloaded.
Please cite Yushkevich et al. 2016 (Greedy) and Ruifrok & Johnston 2001 (colour deconvolution).
